title: FlankerOptions
description: Hand-written for the demo: matches FlankerOptions in jspsych-timelines/packages/flanker (camelCase option names). The `text` option is restricted to its string-valued keys; the function-valued ones (instruction_response, block_complete, result_summary) can't be set from a form.

numPracticeTrials.description: Number of practice trials. 0 skips practice.

numTestTrials.description: Total number of test trials, split across blocks.

includeNeutral.description: Include neutral (dash) flanker trials in addition to congruent and incongruent.

responseDuration.description: Maximum time allowed to respond on each trial.

feedbackDuration.description: How long trial feedback is shown.

showPracticeFeedback.description: Show correct/incorrect feedback after practice trials.

showTestFeedback.description: Show correct/incorrect feedback after test trials.

text.description: Override interface strings (translation). Keys: left_button, right_button, continue_button, correct_feedback, incorrect_feedback, timeout_feedback, fixation, task_complete, and the instruction_* strings.

x-jspsych-presets.label: Quick demo (short)
x-jspsych-presets.description: No instructions, 2 practice and 6 test trials, shorter timings. Good for trying the runner.
